actions.title: fragment-aware wall bands
actions.what: mutual nearest over the OVERLAP (not the whole face) and collinear face fragments treated as one face in the closure safety test; synthetic tests first (fragmented faces, T-junction fragments, a column inside one fragment's strip), freeze, THEN a blind Qortuba re-run
actions.why: H2430's band is not established only because the lower face is drawn as H470 + H471
actions.never: tuning to the 0.3813 m2 core or to a Q-14 value

actions.title: source anchor
actions.what: establish (or refuse) DWG e4babbc2... <-> DXF df0e1d69... identity; re-anchor claims only through a reviewed transfer record

actions.title: reviewed closure / correction workflow
actions.what: REVIEWED and AUTHORISED_FOR_RELEASE as signed records over a TopologyClosure; SOURCE_CORRECTION claims as a separate kind (never merged with closures)

actions.title: trade-layer claims in the engine manifest
actions.what: the Q-14 claim, the space-class rule and footprint policies act in the lab trade layer; R8.11 binds them per row (row_input_digest); move the row manifest into engine/source

actions.title: passage vs open room side
actions.what: a strip between a band end and a perpendicular face 3.45 m away is recorded like a 1.2 m passage (no size rule, by design); a structural rule (both jambs belong to the same wall line, or the strip separates label zones) is needed before any allocation

actions.title: reveal / soffit allocation
actions.what: jamb faces and a soffit (only with a head) are opening surfaces for wall-treatment trades; never also room wall perimeter or ceiling area

actions.title: floor object-footprint authority
actions.what: when it is the sole Q-13 blocker, ask the one prepared owner question; record the answer as a TradeObjectFootprintPolicy (FLOOR_FINISH), never as a quantity
